provenance: AI-assisted first draft from the saved founder brief and research note; retained to show the review step

slides.title: AI is your co-pilot, not autopilot.
slides.body: Let it help with the first pass, but keep final decisions with you.

slides.title: Start with a better brief.
slides.body: Tell the tool what you need, who it is for, and what a useful answer looks like.

slides.title: Don't stop at answer one.
slides.body: Ask for alternatives and gaps, then refine the strongest direction.

slides.title: Check important claims.
slides.body: Open sources and confirm numbers, dates and quotes before publishing.

slides.title: Bring your own point of view.
slides.body: Real examples and your judgment make the work more useful.

slides.title: Test one small workflow.
slides.body: Pick a recurring task, draft with AI, review, and keep only what helps.
